projects.description: Offline Python library and CLI that verifies a separately trusted manifest digest and emits JSON fixtures as their original bytes. Python 3.10+ on Linux; v0.1.1 is an alpha prerelease fixing traversal through directories without listing permission.
Read-only Node.js/TypeScript CLI for Raydium CPMM pool discovery and estimated cross-pool spreads. Node 22+; v0.1.1 fixes response-body timeouts. It does not execute trades.
